days.title: Visitor Center and Northern Basin
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Lalastra
stops.detail: Access to the park is from Lalastra, where the Valderejo Natural Park interpretation center is located, or from the town of Herrán in Burgos.

stops.name: cuenca del río Purón
stops.detail: In the north of the natural park lies the Purón River basin, with a wide valley in the Alava area whose isolation and sparse population have allowed for magnificent conservation of its natural heritage in flora and fauna.

days.title: Gorge and Abandoned Villages
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Ribera
stops.detail: From the Roman period, remains of a road remain, and, in Ribera, for example, a church with Romanesque remains and medieval paintings is preserved standing.

stops.name: desfiladero del río Purón
stops.detail: The Purón River gorge is a perfectly visible example of the karstic action of water on limestone rock.

stops.name: Lahoz
stops.detail: In addition to Lalastra, there are three other rural centers in Valderejo; Lahoz, Villamardones and Ribera.
